transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too. Well, I came in because... I just can't seem to shake this feeling that I've completely failed. I feel like I failed as a father, and, well, just as a useful person in general. It just keeps looping in my head, over and over, until I get to the point where I feel like I really don't deserve much of a future. That's mainly why I'm here.
When did these feelings of failure and hopelessness begin?
It's been... I'd say about a month now. It started right around the time my daughter left for college. She went to a school out of state, and, well, ever since she left, it's just been like this.
Since your daughter left, have you lost interest or pleasure in activities you usually enjoy?

Yeah, I have. I used to really look forward to working on my model railway, and watching the Cubs games with my daughter. But now... the trains just sit there half-built on the table. I haven't touched them in weeks. And even the thought of just turning on a baseball game on the TV... it just feels completely pointless. I just don't have any interest in it anymore.
Have you had thoughts of killing yourself or ending your life?

Yes... I have. I've been having thoughts that it would just be easier if I didn't wake up in the morning. And, well, it actually scared me the other day because I caught myself going over all my finances, almost like I was getting things ready for someone else after I'm gone.
Before this past month, have you ever had a period of depression like this that lasted at least two weeks?

No, I haven't. I mean, sure, I've had bad days before, or felt down for a day or two, but... nothing like this. I've never felt this way for weeks on end before. This is really the first time it's ever been like this.
How has your sleep been since these feelings began?

It hasn't been good. I usually just... lie in bed for hours. The house is too quiet now. And then, when I finally do fall asleep, I always end up waking up around three or four in the morning. I can't get back to sleep after that because my mind just starts running through everything I've messed up.
Since this began, have you been feeling unusually tired or lacking energy during the day?

Yes, very much so. I just don't have any energy. It's gotten to the point where even simple things... like carrying the laundry upstairs, or just sorting through the mail... it feels like I'm moving through wet cement. It doesn't even matter how long I've been in bed, I'm just constantly exhausted.
How much have these symptoms interfered with your ability to carry out your usual work and daily responsibilities?

It's interfered with pretty much everything. I'm not working right now, so it's mostly my daily life at home that's taking the hit. My bills and house projects are just piling up... I look at them, but I just can't make myself follow through on any of it. 

And I've completely stopped seeing the few people I used to count on. I don't go to my book club anymore, I skip the group rides... I just stay home. Honestly, I don't feel safe just brushing this off anymore. It really hit me recently when I started organizing all my finances... setting all my accounts and paperwork up like someone else might need to take them over. That's... that's when I realized how bad this has gotten.
